messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: What must accompany machinery when it is placed on the market?

Facts:
[0] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity (EU declaration of conformity) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[1] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — hasObligation — shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that (shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that) [condition: before placing it on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[2] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by the required documents (accompanied by the required documents) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[3] machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by instructions (instructions) [condition: in the official Community language or languages of the Member State in which it is placed on the market and/or put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4]
[4] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available (ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[5] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the instructions for use (instructions for use and the information referred to in Article 10(7)) [condition: in a language which can be easily understood by users, as determined by the Member State in which the machinery or related product is to be made available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[6] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — a document accompanying the machinery (a document accompanying the machinery) [condition: where the size or nature of the machinery or related product does not allow this] [REG, Art. 10(5)]
[7] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[8] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements (ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[9] machinery — mustAccompany — EC declaration of conformity (ec declaration of conformity) [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[10] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[11] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[12] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: or alternatively, internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[13] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — is accompanied by the required documents (is accompanied by the required documents) [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[14] manufacturer, digital instructions — hasObligation — mark on the machinery or related product (mark on the machinery or related product) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[15] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up (shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[16] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B (shall draw up the technical documentation set out in annex iv, part b) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[17] importers of machinery and related products — hasObligation — shall place only compliant machinery (shall place only compliant machinery) [REG, Art. 13(1)]
[18] machinery bearing the CE marking — mustAccompany — accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity (accompanied by the ec declaration of conformity) [condition: machinery bearing the CE marking and accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity] [DIR, Art. 7(1)]
[19] manufacturers — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[20] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[21] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A (draw up the technical documentation set out in annex iv, part a) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[22] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — must ensure (must ensure) [condition: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[23] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[24] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the instructions for use (accompanied by the instructions for use) [REG, Art. 13(4)]
[25] importers — hasObligation — shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures (shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market] [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[26] distributors — hasObligation — bears the CE marking (bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[27] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [condition: If the shape of the machinery or related product itself or its intended installation does not offer sufficient stability] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.1]
[28] declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — must contain the following particulars (must contain the following particulars) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[29] distributor of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 16(3)]

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["EC declaration of conformity", "EU declaration of conformity", "instructions", "instructions for use", "required documents"], "text": "Machinery placed on the market must be accompanied by the EC or EU declaration of conformity (DIR Art. 5(1); REG Art. 15(2)) and by instructions, including instructions for use (DIR Annex I, 1.7.4; REG Art. 13(4)). Instructions must be in a language easily understood by users, as the Member State determines, and the declaration may be replaced by an internet address or machine-readable code where permitted (REG Art. 10(8)). Other documents may also be required, depending on the case.", "used": [9, 0, 3, 5, 24, 13, 12]}
